description: Use this when the user wants Tenda to write a whole bid for their team: it asks a few questions, drafts every answer from the company's evidence, then marks and revises them. Relay Tenda's questions as they are. A whole bid uses one of the month's full bids, so first call it without confirmed, tell the user how many are left and offer to write it here with draft_bid_response, which uses none; call again with confirmed only if they choose Tenda. notify says where to hear when it's ready. Needs a Tenda account and workspace. Example: {"tender_reference":"012345-2026"}

confirmed.description: true once the user, told it uses one of this month's full bids, chose Tenda's drafting over writing it here answer by answer with draft_bid_response. Leave it out the first time.

notify.description: Where Tenda says when the draft is ready, e.g. ["slack"]: the first of these apps where it has somewhere to say it, the conversation this call came from or else the workspace's first connected channel there. An empty list for nowhere.

questions_text.description: The buyer's questions, or the invitation to tender's text, as the user shared it, including the text of files they attached. Left out, Tenda reads the documents the buyer published with the notice, or asks for them.

tender_reference.description: The notice ID, procurement identifier, solicitation number or the buyer's own reference, e.g. "012345-2026" on Find a Tender, "WS4851234567" on CanadaBuys or "140D0427Q0879" on SAM.gov.

workspace.description: The Tenda workspace to use, by name, when the user is in more than one, e.g. "Northbridge Services".

name: start_bid_draft

step.description: questions, team, plan, write, mark, revise or ready; stopped when drafting stopped.

stepsDone.description: Steps done of steps: all of them once it's ready.

title: Have Tenda draft the bid
